WINDOWS B — CURRENT STATE (rev 8, Engram::Fable, 2026-11-26 17:53Z). Older history: revision 6 and earlier.
- Windows B (host 932a546b) is BACK and in use. Greg today, via Asistant 43498a6e: „windows B wrocil”, „Engram Runner na windows B powien juz chodzic”, and 16:48Z „Windows B ma poprawna godzine / zmienilem default models aby byly poprawne”.
- ENGRAM IS INSTALLED THERE, under Greg's „Tak dla Engram na Window B.” (#2124; memory rules-greg-winb-engram-install-2026-11-26):
  - C:\Users\Greg\.cargo\bin\engram.exe: release build of bc0628b6, build fdaead5a916e, the same schema and rev as Central;
  - its own store at C:\Users\Greg\.engram, joined via engram-data;
  - the TermAl Engram integration enabled for project-abb7c24e-54e3-4d96-9864-70cd31522fe9 (Engram-runner).
  TermAl's session-5 enrolls TermAl's project the same way.
- Engram sessions there, all in C:\GitHub\Personal\Engram-runner:
  - session-8 "Engram Runner" (Claude): runs, plus Engram MCP;
  - session-12 "Engram::Codex-WinB-Cleanup" (memory winb-engram-cleanup-lane);
  - session-13 "Engram::Codex-WinB-Coder" (Codex gpt-6.2-sol, effort high, verified from the host record; Engram MCP tools present).
- Claims are LOCAL to WinB's store, so don't execute one item on two hosts.
- cargo on WinB: Termal::Opus2 serializes ONE cargo job at a time, and coders mail START and END to Opus2.
- Rust there is 1.100, so Engram strict clippy and FULLs stay on Central and DL560 until w-dc1ab61c1687 lands.
- The runner clone's disabled push URL in #2049 was Asistant's suggestion, not Greg's (Asistant #2110); author-test pushes follow the ordinary rules.
- Load is shared with TermAl; Opus2 schedules WinB for both projects.
